t: A robotics kit that pairs a micro:bit with craft materials and sensors.
steps: Buy the kit from BirdBrain Technologies or use the store link or quote form on the official page.
Buy a micro:bit and add it to the kit.
Load the BirdBrain firmware onto the micro:bit.
Open BirdBlox, Snap! or MakeCode on a computer or tablet.
Connect a servo and an LED and run a first program.
Gather craft supplies such as cardboard and tape.
Browse the learning hub for a starter lesson.
